question.text: Light of wavelength λph falls on a cathode plate inside a vacuum tube as shown in the figure. The work function of the cathode surface is ϕ and the anode is a wire mesh of conducting material kept at a distance d from the cathode. A potential difference V is maintained between the electrodes. If the minimum de Broglie wavelength of the electrons passing through the anode is λe, which of the following statement(s) is(are) true ?

solution.text:
Kmax=hcλPh-ϕ
Kinetic energy of e- reaching the anode will be
K=hcλPh-ϕ+eV
Now λe=h2mK=h2mhcλPh-ϕ+eV
If eV≫ϕ
λe=h2mhcλPh+eV
If Vf=4Vi
λef≃λei2
